title: Chrona TimeObservation intake, provenance portion (chrona.time-observation/1)
description: The provenance-bearing portion of a TimeObservation received through the chrona time.record v1 capability (docs/requirements/CHRONA-PROVENANCE.md, CHR-PROV-001..011). Identity is the Praxis actor (schemas/provenance-actor.schema.json, vendored unchanged under vendor/praxis-provenance/); Chrona does not define a second identity model. `provenance` is the Praxis praxis.provenance/1 block received with the observation; it describes the SOURCE. time.record is a create: Chrona stores this block verbatim as source provenance (never appended to; an unsupported major is carried verbatim, a malformed block rejects the observation) and gives the new record its own block (Praxis docs/echelon-provenance-architecture.md, "Creating a record versus relaying one"). This schema is the structural floor; lib/time-observation-intake.mjs enforces the rules JSON Schema cannot express (credential tripwire, contribution-history invariants, interval ordering, agent execution keys). Identity is self-reported provenance, not authentication or authorization (RQ-ROS-2026-A010, RQ-ROS-2026-A019).

observationId.description: Stable id assigned by the source system (§19 ObservationId).

sourceSystem.description: Echelon registry id or other stable source-system id (§19 SourceSystem).

workItemId.description: Optional work item the time was spent on (§19 WorkItemId), e.g. a ROS work item id or `praxis:FEAT-...`.

performer.description: Who performed the work being timed (the activity's ActorId, §5) and, for agent or automated work, the execution that performed it. The actor is a Praxis actor taken only from explicit declarations; an unknown performer is recorded as kind/id 'unknown', never guessed.

execution.description: Praxis execution id (EXE-...) or another Echelon system's execution (EXT-<system>.<run-id>). Absent when not known; never fabricated.

measurement.description: Recorded duration evidence. Absent means Chrona has no duration evidence: the observation is preserved but no time entry can be produced from it (CHR-PROV-004). Values are never estimated from provenance, execution existence, or commit timestamps.

provenance.description: Praxis praxis.provenance/1 interchange block describing this observation (contributions keyed by EXE-/EXT-/CTB-, derivedFrom lineage). Optional: an observation without provenance is valid and reads as unattributed. A block tagged with another major version (praxis.provenance/N, N != 1) is outside this floor and is carried verbatim.

measurementSource.description: Where the duration was recorded: a running timer, a person's manual entry, execution telemetry (for example a finalized Praxis execution record), or an import from another time system.
